asked.item: Why Reconnect shows the maximum connected accounts error for an existing account
What to do about the error (20 connected)

verdict.reason: S79 says reconnecting an existing account counts against the connected-accounts limit and says how to free a slot.

steps.text: Reconnecting an existing account counts against the same connected-accounts limit, so Reconnect fails too until you free a slot.
To free a slot, disconnect an account in Accounts, or upgrade your plan.
